second_pass_decisions.decision: Refresh on an ended worker is the explicit re-probe with bounded backoff
second_pass_decisions.outcome: There is no user-facing Refresh command; the only route into the coordinator is the DATABASE_REFRESHED event. _on_database_refreshed now checks _worker_has_ended first; if conflicts were cleared it republishes capabilities (handler restarts), otherwise it calls the new _restart_ended_worker (shared with the capabilities handler): the unchanged D13 _admit_reprobe_restart backoff, then stop reconfigured and start after a clean stop. A refresh inside the backoff window is dropped, not queued; a live worker, unstarted thread or unknown database is untouched and spends no backoff. Per failure kind: session_expired reconnects; credential_required only if credentials exist; read-only/trust change and non-retryable errors end again if the cause persists; failed first open restarts as a normal start. 10 tests (12 failures before), D9 pins and D13 RestartRule tests stay green under both dispatchers; one D13 pin changed contract (noted); 10 of 10 mutants killed. FINDING (decision): DATABASE_REFRESHED is also published after routine post-write reloads, compaction, the Access change monitor and external reconciliation, so it is not strictly a user gesture: a worker that ends right after a write restarts once immediately without a user click (bounded by the backoff). A strictly user-initiated trigger would need a dedicated event or command.
second_pass_decisions.note: Superseded in part by G1: DATABASE_REFRESHED now restarts an ended worker only for recoverable end reasons.

second_pass_decisions.decision: Marker-query-blocked behaviour pinned
second_pass_decisions.outcome: No production change. With the old writer holding the operation applock, query_operation gets sp_getapplock -1 and raises SqlInfrastructureError LOCKED ("Another session is resolving the same SQL operation."), non-retryable; the worker ends; the operation stays UNCERTAIN (journal record and _uncertain_callbacks entry kept); zero DML replayed; the marker SELECT never runs even if the marker is committed; the failed lookup is rolled back and its connection closed. Once the old writer connection is gone a Refresh restarts the worker and recovery resolves the operation from the marker (COMMITTED/FAILED_BEFORE_COMMIT) with no replay. 2 tests x marker-absent/marker-committed (direct + real worker under the UI dispatcher), 9 of 9 mutants killed. GAP (not changed): the user-visible message is exactly the LOCKED text in the disconnected state; it does NOT tell the user to reconnect. The strict SQL model answers applock -1 immediately (the real 10 s @LockTimeout stall is not modelled).
second_pass_decisions.note: G2 added reconnect guidance to the user message; F6 pins updated by decision.

second_pass_decisions.decision: DATABASE_REFRESHED restarts an ended worker only for recoverable end reasons
second_pass_decisions.outcome: Worker end reason recorded as a private enum _WorkerEndReason on _DatabaseRuntime.end_reason. Recoverable (refresh restarts through the unchanged bounded backoff, injectable clock): LOCKED-uncertain (marker lookup blocked by the old writer lock) and a transient failed first open without retry (DatabaseCatalogError/OSError). Not recoverable (stay stopped until credential re-entry or Reconnect): stop requested, session_expired, credential_required, read_only_required (incl. trust change after connecting), non-retryable error without a flag, unexpected internal error. Suspension gap and ValueError do not end the worker; a retryable failure after establishment never ends it. Clearing conflicts for an unrecoverable end republishes DATABASE_CAPABILITIES_CHANGED inside the own-event guard so nothing restarts. The D13 capability handler is unchanged (it still restarts any ended worker; the coordinator is the only production publisher; no test showed it reintroducing the loop). 17 failures before; 13 new/changed tests; D9 pins (both dispatchers) and the 10 D13 RestartRule tests (UI dispatcher; sync variants in the Refresh tests) green; 18 mutants killed. Caveat: blocked-marker is detected by phase, not exception type, so a flagless error such as database-missing in that phase would classify the same (practically unreachable; a precise check needs a new field on DatabaseCatalogError). AGENTS.md F3 sentence replaced by one restricted sentence.

second_pass_decisions.outcome: New UNION ALL branch (Priority -1, kind bid_locked) in SqlProjectWriter._validate_mutation_locks inside the existing validation batch, after the operation-marker check and the sorted applocks, before the operation. Inner-joins Bids to JobStatuses; applies only to resources with type <> bid and a bid_uid; a Bid counts as locked when Locked IS NULL OR Locked = 1. Refusal is raised before the operation and rolled back: nothing written, no lease consumed; a committed retry is recovered before the check runs. Exemption: DatabaseMutationRequest.bid_lock_exempt (not in the request hash, not forgeable via payload) set only by ProjectWriteService.queue_cancelled_placement_cleanup_delete (takeoffs only; also skips the client queue-time guard); an AST scan test confirms nothing else sets it. Assumed case-insensitivity: (1) schema_validator._validate_core_constraints casefold fallback for foreign keys (schema_validator.py:~203-208) is the only production place that tolerates the spelling; (2) tests state it (tests/integration/sql/test_schema_contract.py:129 resolves table names through a casefold map 'as on the default server collation'; strict_sql_fakes.py:181 compares identifiers case-insensitively). VERIFIED: of 100 bracketed [dbo]/[ostv] table references in production SQL strings every one matches a model table spelling exactly, and the model has 64 tables / 83 foreign keys / 131 indexes where the ONLY spelling mismatch (table, column, index, FK parent or child) is the child table of FK BidPlanrooms_BidUID1; no two table names collide when casefolded. INFERRED (no live server): on a case-sensitive server collation CREATE TABLE [BidPlanRooms] succeeds and only ALTER TABLE [dbo].[BidPlanrooms] ... fails (Msg 4902, object not found), aborting initialization inside the schema-lock transaction. (b) A casefold resolver in render_sql_server_schema (VERIFIED by rendering the model with child_table/parent_table of every FK replaced by the spelling of the casefold map): 278 rendered statements before and after; exactly ONE differs (index 246): before `ALTER TABLE [dbo].[BidPlanrooms] ADD CONSTRAINT [BidPlanrooms_BidUID1] FOREIGN KEY ([BidUID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Bids] ([UID])`, after `ALTER TABLE [dbo].[BidPlanRooms] ADD CONSTRAINT [BidPlanrooms_BidUID1] FOREIGN KEY ([BidUID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Bids] ([UID])` (constraint name keeps the vendor spelling); all 64 CREATE TABLE, 131 CREATE INDEX and the other 82 FK statements are byte-identical. (c) CHECKSUM: schema_definition.py SqlSchemaDefinition.checksum is sha256 over '\n-- statement --\n'.join(self.statements) (= render_sql_server_schema(core_schema) + the ostv extension statements) followed by the canonical_database_requirements; VERIFIED: recomputing it that way reproduces the pin. It therefore hashes the RENDERED DDL TEXT, not the model, so every variant that changes that one statement changes the checksum. Pinned value 0cecca4baced14d54832a90ead0bac84e743875abca98b0eb173903491dec23c (literal pin tests/infrastructure/sql/test_schema_definition.py:158; also test_the_checksum_is_the_sha256_of_statements_then_requirements, ..._depends_on_every_part_of_the_definition, ..._is_stable_across_reads). VERIFIED values: current 0cecca4b...; resolver in the renderer 53ee835fef3347f213bb23c62ea273d9b5bb98f45ea06cfe0f29c43ee1c37287; one-token metadata edit (child_table BidPlanrooms->BidPlanRooms only, reference_schema_metadata.py:464) 53ee835f... (identical to the resolver, because the rendered text is identical; the fixture tests/fixtures/reference_mdb_schema.json:1786 and the Access acceptance test tests/integration/mdb/test_schema_acceptance.py:709 are not hashed, they only pin the vendor MDB spelling and would have to follow the metadata edit); a variant that also renames the constraint to BidPlanRooms_BidUID1 b2a0a3a9...8ed8bd77 (a different value again, not needed). Consequence (read from code): database_creator.py:538 records SQL_SCHEMA_V1.checksum in the new database and schema_validator.py:45 / client_permissions.py:169 (schema_record_is_canonical) reject any database whose stored checksum differs, so every database created with the current v1 would stop validating; AGENTS.md ('only SQL schema is checksummed version 1 ... no alternate checksums, compatibility aliases or runtime upgrade paths; a database that does not validate exactly as canonical v1 is rejected') forbids bridging that, so changing the text is a re-baseline of v1 (new literal pin, databases recreated), acceptable only if no deployed v1 database must survive (not known to me). (d) SMALLEST CHANGE THAT KEEPS THE CHECKSUM VALUE: only one that leaves SqlSchemaDefinition.statements untouched, i.e. a resolver applied at EXECUTION time (database_creator.initialize_blank_database loop `for statement in SQL_SCHEMA_V1.statements: cursor.execute(statement)` resolving the FK table identifiers through a casefold map of the model tables before execute): VERIFIED that statements and the checksum are then unchanged (checksum recomputed unchanged); INFERRED that the validator still passes (its FK casefold fallback and exact table-name checks accept the stored spelling). Cost: the hashed DDL is no longer byte-for-byte the DDL that runs, which weakens the checksum's meaning, and it duplicates a second rendering rule; a render-time resolver or any model edit changes the checksum as shown. Recommended: no change unless a case-sensitive server must be supported (UNVERIFIED that any customer runs one; the default server collation is case-insensitive); if it must, accept the v1 re-baseline with the metadata one-token edit (smallest, keeps one DDL text) rather than an execution-time rewrite.

Mutants killed: recovery no longer finishing the retained entry, cancel ignoring runtime generation, and dropping retained metadata when the cancellation dispatch fails.

methods.name: LicenseApiTransportTests.test_non_object_or_malformed_responses_are_failures

methods.name: LicenseApiTransportTests.test_http_client_error_returns_the_error_body_and_server_error_does_not

methods.name: LicenseApiTransportTests.test_transient_network_failure_is_retried_once

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_smbios_identity_is_stable_across_application_restarts

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_default_identity_path_uses_canonical_v1_filename

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_unrelated_machine_and_session_changes_do_not_affect_hwid

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_first_transient_smbios_failure_does_not_create_fallback

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_pinned_smbios_failure_does_not_change_identity

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_pinned_smbios_identity_with_unusable_firmware_uuid_is_not_replaced
methods.review_note: New sibling: pinned SMBIOS identity + reader returning None (definitively unusable/missing UUID later) must raise 'temporarily unavailable', never switch to an installation UUID (factory not called) and leave the record bytes untouched. This production branch (_verify_pinned_identity observed_uuid is None) had no coverage.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_changed_pinned_smbios_uuid_is_an_explicit_failure
methods.review_note: Strengthened: asserts the persisted record bytes are unchanged after the mismatch failure (not re-pinned to the new UUID); regex 'does not match' pins the specific failure.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_fallback_is_created_once_and_never_switches_to_smbios
methods.review_note: Strengthened: both HWIDs pinned to the exact installation-UUID HWID (previously only first == second). Existing assertions that the later SMBIOS reader is never consulted and the persisted record fields are retained.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_fallback_storage_read_failure_never_regenerates_identity
methods.review_note: Strengthened: asserts the HardwareIdentityError __cause__ is the OSError from the repository (wrapping contract). Factory never called; create_if_absent raising AssertionError would escape as a non-HardwareIdentityError and fail the test.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_missing_pinned_fallback_record_is_not_regenerated
methods.review_note: Strengthened: also asserts the record file is not recreated after the failure (inside the temp dir), on top of factory never being called. Relies on the .initialized marker making the missing record a failure.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_missing_pinned_smbios_record_is_not_recreated_from_firmware
methods.review_note: New sibling of the fallback test: a pinned SMBIOS record deleted after creation must fail with an OSError cause, must not consult the firmware reader at all (calls == 0) and must not recreate the file, even though a different firmware UUID is available.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_corrupt_identity_record_is_not_replaced
methods.review_note: Sound: corrupt JSON raises 'invalid', file content unchanged, no marker created. Complemented by the new content-validation test below.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_invalid_identity_record_contents_are_never_replaced_or_trusted
methods.review_note: New: valid-JSON-but-invalid records (JSON list, wrong version, unknown source, lowercase identifier, generic all-zero UUID, missing identifier) each raise HardwareIdentityError 'invalid', leave the file byte-identical and never consult the firmware reader. Covers MachineIdentity validation as seen through the generator.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_existing_identity_without_marker_is_loaded_and_marked
methods.review_note: Sound: pre-existing record without marker loads, returns build_hwid(identity) exactly, and creates the marker.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_machine_identity_write_permission_failure_is_explicit
methods.review_note: Strengthened: also asserts the message 'unavailable or invalid' in addition to __cause__ being the PermissionError.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_concurrent_fallback_startup_persists_one_atomic_identity
methods.review_note: Strengthened: asserts all 64 results returned, and that the single observed HWID equals build_hwid of the persisted record (so the winner's value is what was persisted). Temp-file glob '.*.tmp' matches JsonRepositoryBase temp naming (verified) so the no-leftover assertion is not vacuous. Candidates differ per generator (uuid4), so divergent values would be detected.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_concurrent_process_startup_observes_one_fallback_identity
methods.review_note: Strengthened the same way: 24 results, one distinct value, equal to the HWID of the persisted record. Genuine multi-process contention via ProcessPoolExecutor with a top-level worker.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_unsupported_per_user_install_id_is_ignored

Now Path.home, USERPROFILE and HOME are patched to the directory containing install_id.txt and both HWIDs are pinned to the exact installation-UUID HWID, so a revived install_id.txt read would change the value.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_uses_windows_firmware_table_api

Existing assertions pin the RSMB provider, table id 0, 0-size probe call and exact second-call size.

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_preserves_windows_error_code_when_size_query_fails

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_reports_missing_error_code_when_size_query_fails

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_preserves_windows_error_code_when_table_read_fails

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_rejects_firmware_table_that_grows_between_calls

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_truncates_to_the_byte_count_written_by_windows

methods.name: HwidV1Tests.test_reader_requires_the_windows_firmware_table_api

Passed natively on an unlocked desktop (fusion/windowsvista/windows11, cancel/save cycles) and failed natively when the winId() regression was injected into windows.py in-process (killed with the dialog test). Fails when the desktop is locked or the window is occluded (environmental).

methods.name: HotlinkCursorLifecycleTests.test_native_legacy_helper_reproduces_despite_placement_cancellation
methods.review_note: Retained: native-only (skip gate legitimate); runs the deliberately corrupting legacy helper in a subprocess and asserts the I-beam leak plus WA_NativeWindow, proving the native assertions can fail. Passed natively (twice standalone, once in the full run); failed once with widgetAt()==None while the desktop was locked/occluded. Subprocess failure output is empty on failure of cleanups, so a locked desktop shows only '1 != 0'. Not changed.

methods.name: DatabaseMaintenanceUiTests.test_sql_result_is_explicit_and_access_denial_is_inert
methods.review_note: Strengthened: Access backend is Mock(spec=IDatabaseMaintenance) and asserts mock_calls == [] (previously only compact was checked, which the handler never calls), the warning title and the exact message prefix are asserted instead of assertIn. Mutant killed: router mapping SQL_SERVER to the Access backend.

methods.name: DatabaseMaintenanceUiTests.test_actions_and_single_result_without_rebuilding_selection
methods.review_note: Strengthened: service is Mock(spec=DatabaseMaintenanceService); the disabled-button click now asserts service.mock_calls == [] (the old 'compact not called' check was vacuous because the handler uses prepare/finish); the shown dialog title/message ('Compact/Repair','result') is asserted for both success and failure. Retained call checks: prepare/finish with the captured target and unload fn.

methods.name: MaintenanceUiOwnershipTests.test_stale_confirmation_and_progress_never_replace_database
methods.review_note: Strengthened: all collaborators spec'd; added an EventBus spy asserting DATABASE_REFRESHED is published exactly once (with the locator) on a current commit and never otherwise; added transition 'commit_cleanup_failure' (commit and refresh succeed, temp-file close raises) asserting the one warning text 'Compact/Repair completed successfully. Temporary-file cleanup failed: temporary file is locked'; added exact assertions that a change/cancel before progress stops silently (backend.prepare never called, no warning). Mutants killed: no refresh event; commit without is_target_current; prepare without target check; handler without post-confirm access recheck; handler without pre-progress is_target_current; confirm bypass; no discard of prepared; swallowed cleanup_error; operation lock not released. Equivalent: service.prepare releasing the target on failure (the handler's finally also releases, and the Access target close is idempotent).

methods.name: MaintenanceUiOwnershipTests.test_database_switch_during_progress_startup_rejects_before_prepare
methods.review_note: Retained: replacement/unload/source switches during progress startup must reject before prepare; spec'd collaborators now. Killed by dropping the service-level is_target_current check in prepare.

methods.name: MaintenanceUiOwnershipTests.test_open_files_projects_access_changes_and_unsubscribes
methods.review_note: Retained: spec'd UIAccessManager records the single subscribe callback; asserts the compact button follows access changes, selection is preserved, unsubscribe is called once with the same callback, and a late delivery after cleanup is inert. Mutants killed: no unsubscribe; compact button ignoring maintenance_allowed_fn.

methods.name: RouterOwnershipSqlCleanupTests.test_missing_sql_descriptor_never_falls_through_to_access
methods.review_note: Retained: unregistered non-.mdb id must raise LookupError('not registered') on both reader and writer routers. Mutants killed: resolve_database_backend returning ACCESS instead of raising; dropping the .mdb suffix fallback is killed by the new test.

methods.name: RouterOwnershipSqlCleanupTests.test_registered_descriptors_and_legacy_mdb_paths_route_to_their_backend
methods.review_note: Added: positive controls for the test above on both routers: registered SQL descriptor id is SQL; registered Access descriptor id, its path, and an unregistered upper-case .MDB path are not SQL. Mutants killed: _is_sql forced False/True on reader and writer, .mdb fallback removed. Equivalent: registry access-locator lookup returning None (the .mdb suffix fallback gives the same backend).

methods.name: DimensionLifecycleTests.test_dimension_measurement_and_scale_do_not_depend_on_render_transform
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added a positive control inside the rescale loop (1:48 -> 1:96 doubles every coordinate, asserted exactly) so the label checks are about a genuinely rescaled line. Mutants killed: dimension distance computed from the transformed (render) points; page-ratio inverted; rotation index not preserved. Equivalent: +1e-3 inch on the label distance (below the 1/64 inch display resolution).

methods.name: DimensionLifecycleTests.test_dimension_label_follows_exact_length_and_page_scale
methods.review_note: Added: independent literal labels (1" -> 2", 1' - 0" -> 2' - 0", 8333' - 4 1/8" -> 16666' - 8 1/4") for the unscaled and 1:96-rescaled dimension, so the label is not checked against the formatter itself.

methods.name: AnnotationFamilyGeometryTests.test_copy_translation_and_scale_preserve_angles_and_dimensions
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added an independent per-kind oracle for translation (text moves only its anchor; ink skips its rotation; others move x/y pairs but not the rotation) and for the 1:48 -> 1:96 rescale (every coordinate doubles except the rotation value); the round-trip assertions are kept. Mutants killed: dy replaced by dx in pair translation, text anchor y not translated, ratio inverted, rotation index rescaled.

methods.name: AttachmentMovementTests.test_legacy_curved_linear_sibling_is_not_a_polygon_backout
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added a positive control by turning the same sibling geometry into an Area condition and asserting _validate_hole_position is False and _check_hole_overlap True, so the original assertions pass because the sibling is a linear. Mutants killed: sibling is_area filter removed in drag_handler and in placement_mode; intersection result ignored.

methods.name: OverlayCoordinateContractTests.test_pdf_boxes_and_intrinsic_rotation_are_normalized_upstream
methods.review_note: Retained: mutants killed: pdf_width mapped from effective_height_pts; intrinsic_rotation forced to 0.

methods.name: OverlayCoordinateContractTests.test_overlay_units_follow_persisted_page_calibration
methods.review_note: Retained: literal oracles for the unit ratio and the stored full-page rect. Mutant killed: ratio inverted (sf1/sf2).

methods.name: OverlayCoordinateContractTests.test_different_page_dimensions_preserve_full_page_size
methods.review_note: Retained: 11x8.5 in at 1:96 round-trips through the storage string back to (0,0,792,612) page points. Mutant killed: width/height swapped in full_page_overlay_rect.

methods.name: OverlayCoordinateContractTests.test_arbitrary_calibration_uses_the_same_full_page_path
methods.review_note: Retained: non-standard calibration (0.3, 15) round-trips to (0,0,720,360); same mutants killed.

methods.name: OverlayCoordinateContractTests.test_invalid_calibration_produces_no_geometry_or_full_page_rect
methods.review_note: Retained: seven invalid calibrations (zero, negative, nan, inf, non-numeric) must yield None, EMPTY_OVERLAY_RECT page points and a ValueError from full_page_overlay_rect; the valid cases in the sibling tests are the positive control. Mutant killed: dropping the isfinite(ratio) guard. Equivalent: dropping the isfinite(sf1) guard (nan/inf are rejected by the ratio checks).

methods.name: PageScaleSurfaceSyncRegressionTests.test_authoritative_rescale_preserves_display_geometry_without_hybrid_jump
methods.review_note: Retained: mutants killed: factor inverted in position_rescale_factor_between_page_scales; coordinate system ignoring scale_ratio.

methods.name: TakeoffLifecyclePrecisionTests.test_area_and_rotation_pivot_are_translation_independent_for_slivers
methods.review_note: Retained: expectations computed from exact dimensions after translation (tests cancellation, not input rounding). Mutant killed: calculate_polygon_area without the origin shift. Survived: polygon_centroid without the origin shift (the zero-area fallback hides it for a rectangle) which is why the asymmetric test was added.

methods.name: TakeoffLifecyclePrecisionTests.test_asymmetric_polygon_pivot_is_translation_independent_for_slivers
methods.review_note: Added: right trapezoid whose centroid (22/9, 4*size/9) differs from its vertex mean, at offsets 0 and 1e8 and thicknesses 0.1 and 1e-4. Mutant killed: polygon_centroid without the origin shift (fails both 1e8 subtests).

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_action_handler_chaos_default_seeds
methods.review_note: Strengthened (via the harness it runs): paste actions now assert every newly created Takeoff/annotation lands on the current page, and the clipboard invariant now also rejects copied Named Views. Mutants killed by the random walk: delete without Named View cascade. Previously surviving mutants now killed: paste forced to page 'p1'; copy of Named Views.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_chaos_walk_is_deterministic_and_reaches_mutating_actions
methods.review_note: Added: runs each default seed twice and asserts identical action histories and identical final takeoff/annotation models, 35 actions each, and that the three default walks together reached at least one takeoff paste, one annotation paste, one annotation delete and non-no-op undo, redo and delete_selection. Guards against the walk silently degrading into selection-only no-ops.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_long_walks_keep_orphan_invariant_when_hotlinks_follow_restored_views
methods.review_note: Added (renames test_long_walks_keep_orphan_invariant_when_hotlink_restores_are_refused; contract changed by user decision A): seeds 1, 18, 62, 65 x 100 steps keep the orphan-Hot Link invariant, now with zero refused inserts, zero show_warning calls and at least one Hot Link insert so the walk is not vacuous. The invariant itself is unchanged. Killed by skipping the re-point and by dropping the dependency from the delete history paths.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_known_sequence_copy_paste_keeps_current_page_scope
methods.review_note: Retained: exact scripted sequence (select all, copy, switch page, paste) asserting pasted takeoffs and annotations exist and are all on p2. Killed by forcing paste to page p1.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_known_sequence_declined_named_view_delete_keeps_linked_hotlink
methods.review_note: Retained: declined confirmation keeps both the Named View and its Hot Link (exact remaining set); positive control is the confirmed-delete test.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_known_sequence_confirmed_named_view_delete_removes_linked_hotlink
methods.review_note: Retained: confirmed delete removes the Named View and its Hot Link (assertNotIn on exact keys; the declined test is the positive control). Killed by removing the cascade.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_paste_retains_hotlink_to_existing_named_view
methods.review_note: Retained: copying only a Hot Link and pasting on the other page yields exactly one new hot link still pointing at p1-named. Crosses real clipboard + real paste payload preparation.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_paste_skips_stale_hotlink_but_keeps_other_clipboard_annotations
methods.review_note: Retained: after the target Named View is deleted, pasting skips the stale Hot Link but still pastes the text (len(after) > len(before) is a positive control). Killed by disabling the dangling-hotlink filter in AnnotationWriteCoordinator.filter_copyable_annotations.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_known_sequence_hotlink_undo_follows_named_view_restored_under_new_uid
methods.review_note: Added (renames ..._after_named_view_restore_is_rejected_cleanly): delete Hot Link, delete its Named View, undo twice through the real handler and UndoRedoService; the link is restored onto the Named View's new uid (ann-1000) and accepted by the validating write fake; no rejected insert, no warning; redo/redo then undo/undo keeps the link pointing at the restored view.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_known_sequence_cascade_delete_undo_remaps_hotlink_to_restored_view
methods.review_note: Added: positive control that a cascade Named View delete restores its Hot Link remapped to the restored view's new uid and is accepted by the validating fake. Killed mutants: dropping the remap lookup or the same-batch live set in the fake.

methods.name: PlanViewActionHandlerChaosTests.test_known_sequence_hotlink_undo_without_named_view_deletion_restores_link
methods.review_note: Added: positive control that a Hot Link delete undone while its Named View is live is accepted and keeps its target, with zero refused inserts.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_follows_named_view_restored_under_new_uid
methods.review_note: Added (renames ..._restored_under_new_uid_is_refused; old contract replaced by user decision A, not a weakening): real handler + UndoRedoService + AnnotationWriteCoordinator + ProjectWriteService over the sqlite MDB writer; after delete link, delete view, undo, undo the persisted link row targets the NEW view uid (10), the model matches, no failed mutation, no warning.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_follows_named_view_through_redo_undo_cycles
methods.review_note: Added: three redo/redo/undo/undo cycles keep exactly one link row pointing at the restored view and never a failed mutation.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_refused_when_named_view_was_not_restored
methods.review_note: Added: negative control. The Named View is deleted by another history owner (lifetime event) and never restored; undo of the Hot Link is refused with a warning mentioning the Named View, nothing written, no dangling row, entry kept; repeating the undo refuses the same way.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_not_repointed_to_unrelated_named_view_reusing_the_uid
methods.review_note: Added: negative control. An unrelated Named View reuses uid 5 after the other-owner deletion; the old code would silently re-point at it. Now refused (no wrong re-point, no row). Kills the ignore-availability / raw uid equality mutants.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_refused_after_history_cleared
methods.review_note: Added: negative control. After history is cleared nothing is undoable, no Hot Link is written and the retained lifetimes are not reactivated.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_refused_when_named_view_uid_belongs_to_another_page
methods.review_note: Added: negative control. Same uid live on another Page (page ownership differs); refused with warning, nothing written.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_placement_redo_follows_named_view_restored_by_cascade_delete
methods.review_note: Added: placement redo (_insert_annotations_with_undo) reproduced the same gap (redo refused); place a link, cascade-delete its view, undo, undo, redo; the placement is redone onto the restored view's new uid.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_paste_redo_follows_named_view_restored_by_cascade_delete
methods.review_note: Added: same for _push_mdb_paste_history redo of a pasted Hot Link payload through the real paste composite.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_paste_redo_of_named_view_with_its_hotlink_keeps_same_batch_remap
methods.review_note: Added: a pasted Named View plus its Hot Link in one batch keeps the writer's same-batch remap on redo even after the ORIGINAL view was deleted and restored under another uid (same-batch views are not dependencies). Kills the batch-exclusion mutant.

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_refused_when_named_view_vanished_without_lifetime_event
methods.review_note: Added: negative control. The retained target still looks available but the Named View is gone from model and database; refused by the liveness check before any write (warning, no failed mutation).

methods.name: HotlinkUndoAgainstPersistenceValidationTests.test_hotlink_undo_with_live_named_view_restores_target
methods.review_note: Retained/strengthened: positive control; Named View never deleted, the Hot Link keeps its original target and no warning is shown. Harness now persists inserts and deletes in sqlite (self.ops, PersistedDelete) and patches show_warning.

methods.name: AnnotationDeletionScopeTests.test_late_successful_replay_delete_notifies_peers_after_origin_history_clear
methods.review_note: Strengthened: positive control that both targets are available before the clear, origin's own target is unavailable after clear(), and the peer's target becomes unavailable only through the published event. Mutants killed: event never published; peer invalidation not applied. Equivalent: ignoring the own-history_owner guard (the origin's deleted targets are already suspended).

methods.name: AnnotationDeletionScopeTests.test_rebind_after_history_clear_does_not_resurrect_cleared_targets
methods.review_note: Added: a retained suspended target is rebound by a restore (positive control), but after history.clear() a late rebind must neither change the UID nor make it available. Mutant killed: dropping the 'id(target) in retained' filter in rebind_restored_annotations.

methods.name: AnnotationFamilyHistoryTests.test_every_family_replays_after_restore_uid_reuse_and_scale
methods.review_note: Retained: for 13 annotation families x MDB/SQL, a move followed by delete is undone twice with a reused UID and a rescaled page; asserts restored geometry equals an independent rescale oracle, the reused annotation is untouched, and redo/redo returns to the exact state. Mutants killed: annotation history positions not rescaled (H5); rebind not updating the target uid (H8); SQL geometry queue dropping annotation changes (A4).

methods.name: AnnotationFamilyHistoryTests.test_family_scoped_late_sql_completion_does_not_repopulate_history
methods.review_note: Retained: for every family a late SQL completion after undo.clear() must not recreate history (assertFalse(can_undo)). No mutant was run specifically against this test (the generic clear()-invalidation mutant is killed by other tests in the batch).

methods.name: MixedAnnotationFailureTests.test_failed_restore_does_not_project_early_named_views
methods.review_note: Retained: a writer that fails the second family must leave data.annotations empty and return []. Killed by removing the committed-outcome check in insert_saved_annotations.

methods.name: MixedAnnotationFailureTests.test_detached_copy_excludes_named_view_and_preserves_existing_link_target
methods.review_note: Retained: real detached window copy/paste copies the Hot Link but not the Named View and keeps the link target. Killed by letting Named Views be copyable in the detached window.

methods.name: CrossFamilyReplayTests.test_same_uid_across_families_move_delete_restore_and_replay_remains_typed
methods.review_note: Retained: the same UID '1' across 13 families, move + delete + two restores with reused UIDs; asserts typed positions before/after and that reused annotations keep [999,999]. Independent dict-of-kind oracles.

methods.name: CrossFamilyReplayTests.test_restore_failure_uses_one_application_mutation_and_no_success_event
methods.review_note: Retained: the real ProjectWriteService composite is made to fail on the second family; asserts exactly one mutation call, two use-case calls, no model change, no events and no reload. Killed by projecting before commit (early projection mutant).

methods.name: TextAnnotationHistoryTests.test_older_edit_follows_delete_restore_instead_of_reused_uid
methods.review_note: Retained: for MDB/SQL x text/style/position/rotation, an older edit follows the restored annotation rather than a reused UID across two restore cycles; exact before/after values and unrelated annotation untouched.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: for MDB/SQL x text/style/position/rotation an older edit must follow the restored annotation (restored-N) across two delete/restore cycles while an unrelated annotation reusing uid 'a1' keeps its text, geometry and default colour; every phase asserts literals (before/after), so neither the oracle nor the fixture holds the answer. Agrees with the first pass. Positive controls are in-line (restored values asserted after redo as well as undo).

methods.name: TextAnnotationHistoryTests.test_delete_undo_restores_annotation_at_current_page_scale
methods.review_note: Added: delete, then recalibrate the page 1:1 -> 1:2, then undo must restore at the current scale (position [20,20,160,48]) for both the MDB insert and the SQL paste payload. Mutant killed (it survived the existing suite): _saved_annotations_for_current_scales not rescaling.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: after a 1:1 -> 1:2 recalibration the restore spec must be [20,20,160,48] (independent literal) for the MDB insert call and the SQL paste payload; the sql loop is a real parameter, not a skip. Agrees; the first-pass mutant (restore not rescaling) is also what annotation_history positions() mutants hit.

methods.name: TextAnnotationHistoryTests.test_late_sql_edit_completion_does_not_recreate_cleared_history
methods.review_note: Retained: late SQL completion after clear must not recreate history. The positive path (completion creates history) is covered by the neighbouring tests via complete_edit.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass DISAGREES with 'Retained': the original body only asserted can_undo() False after clear(), which also passes if a SQL completion never records history. Strengthened: a control handler first completes the same text edit undisturbed (can_undo False before the callback, True after), then the original clear-before-completion flow must stay False. Mutation: replacing the forward-mutation currency check with True makes the second half fail; control proves the flow is live.

methods.name: TextAnnotationHistoryTests.test_creation_undo_after_independent_delete_restore_uses_restored_identity
methods.review_note: Retained: undoing a creation after the annotation was deleted and restored under a new uid removes the restored annotation and not a later reused uid 'a1' (exact final list).
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: create -> delete -> restore under a new uid -> reused 'a1' appears -> undo of the creation must remove only the restored annotation (exact final list [reused]). A rebinding mutant (undo by raw uid) would delete the reused one. Agrees.

methods.name: TextAnnotationHistoryTests.test_create_edit_move_resize_undo_redo_chain_preserves_exact_geometry
methods.review_note: Retained: four-step create/edit/move/resize chain undone fully then redone with a reallocated uid; exact position and text compared to literals.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: four-step chain with non-trivial floats (10.015625, 80.000125) undone entirely and redone with a reallocated uid; exact position and text literals. Deterministic. Agrees.

methods.name: TextAnnotationHistoryTests.test_sql_geometry_history_replays_at_current_page_scale
methods.review_note: Retained: SQL queued geometry undo after a page recalibration sends [20,20,160,48] (independent literal).
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: SQL queued geometry undo after a recalibration sends [('a1','text',[20,20,160,48])] (independent literal; page scale mutated on the shared Page object). Agrees.

methods.name: DetachedTextHistoryTests.test_late_sql_text_completion_cannot_recreate_invalidated_history
methods.review_note: Retained: detached window late SQL completion after history.clear() leaves can_undo False.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass DISAGREES with 'Retained' for the same reason as the main-window twin: no positive control. Strengthened: an undisturbed queue + completion first records history (can_undo True), then clear(), queue again, clear() again and complete late -> can_undo False. Re-run clean.

methods.name: DetachedTextHistoryTests.test_detached_sql_history_rebinds_deleted_text_and_rescales_geometry
methods.review_note: Retained: detached geometry history rebinds to the restored uid and rescales after a page scale change; exact payload [('restored','text',[20,20,160,48])].
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: pushes a detached SQL geometry history entry, suspends/rebinds the target through the real UndoRedoService (restored uid, unrelated 'text' appended), doubles scale_factor2 and undoes: payload must be [('restored','text',[20,20,160,48])]. Exercises AnnotationHistoryBinding.positions/rebind through the real window. Agrees.

methods.name: DetachedTextHistoryTests.test_detached_local_edit_delete_restore_rebinds_older_history
methods.review_note: Retained: detached edit/delete/restore with an unrelated reused 'text' uid; exact text values after undo/redo and final uid list.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: detached MDB edit -> delete -> undo(restore as 'restored') -> unrelated 'text' reused -> undo (text back to Before on the restored one, Unrelated untouched) -> redo/redo; the final uid list is asserted. Agrees; the coordinator is the real AnnotationWriteCoordinator over a recording writer.

methods.name: DetachedTextHistoryTests.test_main_history_rejects_text_deleted_in_detached_then_uid_reused
methods.review_note: Retained: a delete in the detached window invalidates the main window history via the real event bus so undo does not touch a reused uid.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: the detached delete invalidates the MAIN window history through the real event bus (ANNOTATION_LIFETIMES_DELETED subscription is wired in the test), so main undo must leave the reused 'Unrelated' text alone. Concern checked: without a positive control the assertion also holds if the main entry were simply gone; mutating UndoRedoService.invalidate_deleted_annotation_lifetimes to a no-op makes this test fail (the entry exists and would rewrite the reused uid). Retained, agrees.

methods.name: DetachedTextHistoryTests.test_late_detached_sql_delete_still_invalidates_other_window_history
methods.review_note: Retained: a late SQL delete completion still invalidates the other window's history; asserts the unrelated annotation text and that the detached history cannot undo.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: a delete completion that arrives after the detached history was cleared must still invalidate the other (main) history and leave the unrelated reused text; also asserts the detached history cannot undo. Agrees.

methods.name: AnnotationDeletionScopeTests.test_shared_delete_command_keeps_source_reference_map_across_repeated_restores
methods.review_note: Strengthened: stateful uid allocation for the fake writer and new assertions that each history target follows its own family's restored uid ({'namedview': view-N, 'hotlink': link-N}), that targets are available after undo and unavailable after redo (previously only the Hot Link's BidPageViewUID was checked). Mutants killed: rebind map reversed; Named View ref remap dropped in insert_saved_annotations; binding keeping the old uid when restoring.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: DeleteAnnotationsCommand over a binding from the real coordinator, two undo/redo cycles with a stateful uid allocator; asserts the Hot Link's BidPageViewUID follows the restored Named View each cycle, each target follows its own family's identity ({'namedview': view-N, 'hotlink': link-N}), and targets are available after undo / unavailable after redo. The allocator is stateful (the first-pass fixture note about the stateless fake no longer applies). Agrees.

methods.name: HotlinkViewLifetimeHistoryTests.test_mdb_delete_history_hotlink_follows_restored_named_view
methods.review_note: Added: _push_mdb_delete_history path; two cycles of undo/undo/redo/redo; the restored Hot Link spec carries the restored Named View's uid each time.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass (freshly written code): two cycles through _push_mdb_delete_history; after the view restore the link spec carries view-N; asserted both through the insert call and the projected link; warning patched and asserted not shown. A fake that returns the same uid every time is avoided by per-cycle next_uids. Agrees.

methods.name: HotlinkViewLifetimeHistoryTests.test_mdb_delete_history_refuses_hotlink_when_named_view_was_not_restored
methods.review_note: Added: MDB delete history refusal when the view was deleted elsewhere and an unrelated view reused the uid: warning, no insert, entry kept.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: view deleted by another history owner and an unrelated view reuses the uid; undo must warn (message mentions Named View), insert nothing, keep the uid list and keep the entry undoable. This is the refusal-instead-of-guess contract of resolve_hotlink_view_targets (also covered directly in test_annotation_history). Agrees.

methods.name: HotlinkViewLifetimeHistoryTests.test_sql_delete_history_hotlink_follows_restored_named_view
methods.review_note: Added: _push_sql_delete_history (fake queue); the queued restore payload of the Hot Link carries the new view uid after the view's SQL restore map is accepted.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: SQL delete history; the restore payload of the Hot Link carries the Named View's NEW uid only after the accepted restore map (sql_result with created_uid_maps) rebinds it. The restore map is delivered by the test, so ordering of real SQL completions is a fake. Agrees.

methods.name: HotlinkViewLifetimeHistoryTests.test_sql_paste_history_redo_hotlink_follows_restored_named_view
methods.review_note: Added: _push_sql_paste_history redo (placement/paste) follows the restored view; the retained payload spec itself is untouched.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: redo of a recorded placement resolves BidPageViewUID to the restored view in the NEW paste while the retained payload spec stays 'view' (no mutation of retained history). Asserted both. Agrees.

methods.name: RealAccessConnectionWorkflowTests.test_real_access_scenarios_run_in_an_isolated_process
methods.review_note: Added (second pass, REAL ACCESS via DAO+ODBC in a child process): runs four scenarios that ran unskipped here: (1) a rolled-back mutation leaves no rows and the writer handle is reused (killed by removing MdbWriter's conn.rollback()); (2) IntegrityError 23000 on the second statement rolls back the first, ProgrammingError 42S02 on a read is a statement error, handles are reused (killed by making the replacement probe always True); (3) close_database(path.upper()) closes both real handles and data is still readable (killed by closing only the read pool); (4) routed Access vs SQL UID allocation: real MAX([UID]) and inbound MasterPageUID scan give 8 / 13 / [13,14,15] with one scan per batch, SQL scope on the same cursor issues no statement and returns deferred identities (killed by dispatching either branch to the wrong backend). The child process is required: ACE retains client tasks and fails with 08004/-1036 after ~60 connections per process, and the integration suite already sits at that ceiling (an in-process version made test_schema_acceptance fail at connection 61). Scenario methods are named scenario_* so discovery never runs them in-process; mutation checks ran them in-process via mutrun.

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: drives the real _run_worker through start_session/initial_reconciliation until the real _project_session_start callback is queued (a dispatch stub raises StartupQueued so the worker stops deterministically; no thread, no sleep), then navigates and delivers it: rejected, ready_event set, FULL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED published exactly once, bid/page identity kept. methods.name: CreationIdentityCreationDialogIdentityTests.test_actual_dialog_registers_selected_runtime_and_reopens_with_its_credentials

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentEnvironmentIntegrationTests.test_authentication_encryption_and_engine_capabilities

Version floor 16.0.4262.2 is an environment assumption.

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentEnvironmentIntegrationTests.test_change_tracking_rowversion_transactions_and_application_locks
methods.review_note: Retained (live, not executed): change tracking retention settings, an insert visible through CHANGETABLE as 'I', rollback leaves value and rowversion untouched, and two sessions prove an exclusive application lock blocks then frees. Works only inside a marker-verified disposable database.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass (independent read before the first-pass note; no disagreement unless stated): GATED, static: real server observables (CT enabled, CHANGETABLE insert, rolled-back update leaves rowversion unchanged, sp_getapplock grant/deny/regrant with session owner); disposable database dropped by the context manager. min_valid_version >= 0 mainly asserts non-NULL.

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentEnvironmentIntegrationTests.test_executor_cannot_bypass_guarded_database_procedures
methods.review_note: Strengthened (live, not executed): server marker verified first. Retained: the executor's raw CREATE DATABASE and DROP DATABASE must raise, a CreateDatabase call with a wrong server marker must raise and leave no database, and if the bypass ever succeeded the finally block would add the run marker and drop through the guarded procedure.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass (independent read before the first-pass note; no disagreement unless stated): GATED, static: direct CREATE/DROP DATABASE must be denied; if CREATE unexpectedly succeeds the finally block cleans up through the guarded proc. Leftover risk: if CreateDatabase accepted the bad server marker, OSTV_IT_MARKER_DENIED_* would remain (not cleaned): reported, not changed because it cannot be exercised here.

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentEnvironmentIntegrationTests.test_disposable_database_is_removed_after_test_failure
methods.review_note: Strengthened (live, not executed): added the positive control that the database exists inside the with block before the deliberate failure; previously a harness that never created it would also pass. Retained: after the RuntimeError unwinds, DB_ID is NULL.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass (independent read before the first-pass note; no disagreement unless stated): GATED, static: second pass added addCleanup(database.drop) so a regression of __exit__ cannot leak the database after the (then failing) test; DB_ID is NULL afterwards on the master connection; positive control retained.

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentEnvironmentIntegrationTests.test_guarded_restore_preserves_data_and_database_marker
methods.review_note: Retained (live, not executed): backup under ProgramData, guarded RestoreDatabase and ValidateRestoredDatabase, restored data and run marker verified by compare_digest; the restored database is dropped only if its marker verified, and the backup file is removed in finally. Windows-auth steps need the local admin the harness already requires.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass (independent read before the first-pass note; no disagreement unless stated): GATED, static: restore through guarded procs, marker compared with compare_digest, backup file removed in finally; restored database dropped only once its marker is proven (a failure between RESTORE and verification leaves OSTV_IT_RESTORE_*: reported).

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentEnvironmentIntegrationTests.test_temporary_reader_editor_and_admin_role_boundaries
methods.review_note: Strengthened (live, not executed): server marker is verified before any login is created, and login creation moved into the try whose finally drops all three OSTV_IT_TMP_ logins. Retained: exact 9-value permission tuples for reader, editor and administrator, reader INSERT must raise, editor DML works and editor DDL must raise.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass (independent read before the first-pass note; no disagreement unless stated): GATED, static: marker check first, then login creation inside try so the finally drops every login that exists (IF SUSER_ID ... DROP LOGIN); exact permission tuples per role from the server. Pooled ODBC connections of a dropped login are a possible environment risk (pre-existing).

methods.name: WriteTokenOrderingCollaborationTests.test_queued_mutation_conflict_is_published_only_after_qt_dispatch

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: genuine: with publish_conflict_event=False the CONFLICT result publishes nothing; the dispatcher delivers the completion before the conflict event, both on the delivering thread. The thread identities compare the main thread with itself by construction of the synchronous dispatcher (so the thread assertions are weak, the ordering/deferral assertions are the real checks). Agrees with the first pass (publishing without the flag / completing without the dispatcher killed).

methods.name: WriteTokenOrderingCollaborationTests.test_many_rapid_local_mutations_advance_expected_token_each_commit

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: genuine: 100 sequential commits present tokens 1..100 (each presented token must equal the executor's current one, otherwise CONFLICT) so a missing apply_result fails at the second call. Agrees with the first pass.

methods.name: WriteTokenOrderingCollaborationTests.test_write_services_share_one_database_token_mutation_scope

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: genuine: two services on one token service never overlap in the executor (an overlap flag set under a lock) and both commit (final token 3). Timing: the first executor call holds for the negative window; a regression needs the second thread to arrive within it (now 0.25 s). Mutants re-run: removing the scope from the write path, un-sharing the lock (not storing it) both KILLED.

methods.name: WriteTokenOrderingCollaborationTests.test_database_token_clear_waits_for_inflight_mutation
methods.review_note: Retained: clear_database stays blocked while a mutation is in flight (bounded negative wait plus positive completion after release) and then empties the tokens. Killed: removing the scope from clear_database, un-sharing the lock, removing the scope from the write path.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_prepares_off_thread_and_applies_on_callback_thread
methods.review_note: Proves prepare runs on a worker thread and apply runs only when the bridged callback is invoked on the caller thread. Strengthened: the old assertNotEqual compared a list to [caller_thread] (passes for an empty list or two entries); now asserts exactly one preparation thread that differs from the caller, and that the bridge queue is drained. Mutants 'callback not bridged' and 'prepare on caller' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree with first pass. Asserts preparation runs on a worker thread and apply/complete run on the callback thread with the prepared value; fails if prepare ran inline or apply ran on the worker (mutants dropping the queued dispatch killed).

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_coalesces_pending_updates_without_losing_completion

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. Two pending submissions merge into one apply but BOTH completions fire with the same result; the added ordering test pins the argument order of coalesce/can_coalesce.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_incompatible_pending_update_is_rejected_before_replacement
methods.review_note: Manual pool; incompatible pending is rejected (False) at replacement time, stale in-flight completes False through is_current. Strengthened: apply now records its argument and the test asserts only ('new', 4) was applied (previously apply returned True blindly). Mutants 'can_coalesce bypassed', 'superseded reported True', 'is_current skipped' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. An incompatible pending update is rejected (completion False) before it replaces the queued one; positive control is the compatible-coalescing test next to it.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_stale_result_is_not_applied_and_submit_after_cleanup_is_rejected
methods.review_note: Renamed from ..._and_cleanup_rejects_pending: it never had a pending submission, it proves a stale result is not applied (completion False) and submit after cleanup completes False. The cleanup-with-pending behaviour is now covered by the new test below. Mutant 'submit after close accepted' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. A result from before cleanup is never applied and a post-cleanup submit completes False; the added duplicate/stale delivery test covers the generation guard on a live pipeline.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_compatible_pending_update_is_coalesced_when_can_coalesce_allows
methods.review_note: NEW: sibling of the incompatible-pending test; with can_coalesce returning True the pending request is merged ((a,2)+(a,4) -> (a,6)) and all three completions get True. Covers the can_coalesce-true branch that was untested. Mutant 'coalesce dropped' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. can_coalesce True merges; kills mutants inverting the predicate result.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_cleanup_rejects_in_flight_and_pending_and_ignores_late_result
methods.review_note: NEW: cleanup while one request is in flight and one pending completes both False immediately, a late bridged result is not applied and does not re-complete, a second cleanup is a no-op and no worker is started. Mutant 'cleanup not completing pending' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. Cleanup rejects the in-flight and the pending submission exactly once and the late worker result is ignored; strengthened by the new exactly-once tests for cleanup inside apply and inside a failing worker start.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_completion_cleanup_does_not_start_a_queued_worker

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. A completion that calls cleanup must not start the queued pending worker (checked through the pool's start count).

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_completion_exception_does_not_drop_other_transactions
methods.review_note: A raising completion on transaction 1 must not stop the queued transaction 2 from running (2,True). Strengthened: the raising callback now runs under assertLogs at ERROR so the logged-failure contract is asserted and the traceback no longer leaks to stderr. Mutant 'completion exceptions unguarded' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. A raising completion does not stop the next transaction's completion (loop continues).

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_completion_exception_does_not_skip_coalesced_sibling_completions
methods.review_note: NEW: a raising completion among coalesced siblings must not skip the following completion in the same transaction (guards the per-callback try/except in _invoke_completions). Mutant 'completion exceptions unguarded' killed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: agree. Sibling completions of a coalesced update all run even if the first raises.

methods.name: RemotePlanUpdatePipelineTests.test_worker_start_failure_rejects_submission_and_allows_retry

methods.name: UIEventCoordinatorDeleteCurrentPageTests.test_sql_page_delete_queues_without_calling_synchronous_writer
methods.review_note: Asserts the queue call args and staged next page; strengthened with the queued completion callback: a COMMITTED result keeps the staged restore and reports nothing, a failed result clears the stage and reports a critical Delete Page error (mutations of both detected).
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: covers COMMITTED (staged selection kept) and CONFLICT (cleared + critical). FINDING (needs decision): _on_queued_page_delete_complete also clears the staged selection restore for the interim COMMIT_STATUS_UNKNOWN / COMMITTED_PROJECTION_FAILED results, although the SQL coordinator retains the callback and calls it again with the recovered final result (sql_collaboration_coordinator._uncertain_callbacks); sibling handlers (bid areas, page settings, rename, scale) return silently on those two statuses. The staged-restore contract is not written down, so not changed and not pinned. Superseded (sweep): the finding about interim results clearing the staged selection was resolved by decision D6; the new D6/D7p tests in this class pin the interim-keeps / terminal-clears contract.

Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 37 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedRemotePlanUpdateTests.test_detached_projection_without_capturable_page_registers_nothing

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_manager_constructor_rolls_back_partial_subscriptions

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Real constructor with an event bus failing the 4th subscribe: the original RuntimeError is re-raised, the three earlier subscriptions are removed (list empty) and exactly 4 attempts were made. The real QtVoidCallback/RemotePlanUpdatePipeline are built and cleaned (not asserted individually; covered by the next test and the world test). Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 14 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_manager_constructor_reports_rollback_failures_with_the_cause

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Subscribe fails on the 3rd call and every unsubscribe fails: an ExceptionGroup with exactly [cause, unsubscribe failed, unsubscribe failed] in that order, and unsubscription happened in REVERSE subscription order (PAGE_METADATA_CHANGED then DATABASE_REFRESHED). Exact literals. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 14 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_stale_open_completion_cannot_commit_window_after_projects_navigation

Strong and multi-stage. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 50 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_shutdown_during_window_construction_discards_the_new_window
methods.review_note: Added. shutdown() invalidates the in-flight open generation: the window built meanwhile is closed, never shown, and no lifecycle remains (kills removal of the lifecycle-generation bump in shutdown).

Fixture nulls collaborators before shutdown so the stub manager survives; kills mutations of the lifecycle-generation compare. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 35 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_new_bid_open_wins_over_reentrant_old_bid_completion
methods.review_note: Re-entrant close+open leaves exactly one live window for the new bid and the old call returns ''. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Window construction for the OLD bid re-enters close_view and open_view(new bid): the outer open returns an empty string, the nested open returns a view uid, two windows exist, first closed, second the manager's window, exactly one open. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 43 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_reentrant_hotlink_target_supersedes_normal_open_target
methods.review_note: Uses the real OpenAnnotationViewUseCase; hotlink target page/named view win over the normal open. Sound.

Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 43 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_create_window_defers_first_show_until_after_manager_setup
methods.review_note: Strengthened: besides factory options and the exact call order, now asserts the manager owns the constructed window and undo service, registered exactly its access listener and connected both interaction signals to its handlers.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: _create_window with FakeConstructedWindow and a fake access manager: returns True, factory got the initial geometry/maximized option, window/undo service/listener (the manager's own bound _refresh_access_state) and both signal connections are registered, and the call ORDER is set_access_state, destroyed_connected, show_when_page_ready (show deferred until setup is complete). methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_create_window_releases_partial_window_when_setup_fails
methods.review_note: Failure in show_when_page_ready releases listener, interaction state, window and undo service and closes the window. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: show_when_page_ready raises: the error propagates, window and undo service are cleared, the access listener and the surface interaction (set before via set_area_placement_active) are released, and close is the last call. Positive precondition (interaction set) is in the test. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 39 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_open_view_blocks_reentrant_duplicate_window_creation_while_opening
methods.review_note: Exact call list proves a duplicate open during construction returns the in-flight view uid and creates nothing. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: A second open_view for the same Bid/page/no named view issued from inside _create_window returns the first view uid without a second create_view; the call list is exact and _opening is cleared afterwards. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 28 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_open_view_can_reopen_after_close
methods.review_note: Exact lifecycle call list for open/close/open and cleared opening guard. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: open, close_view, open again yields view-1 then view-2 with the exact call sequence including the notify after close; _opening False. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 27 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_old_destroyed_signal_cannot_clear_reopened_detached_window
methods.review_note: A late destroyed signal of the old window id must not clear the replacement window; mutation (ignoring the id) is caught.

Note: _on_window_destroyed(id) with self._window None cannot be distinguished from the id compare (id(None) is never a window id) - recorded as an equivalence proof for the 'drop bool operand 0' mutant of line 293. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 12 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_open_view_clears_opening_guard_when_window_creation_fails
methods.review_note: Strengthened: error is matched, and after the failure a subsequent open works and returns the new view (guard really cleared, not just a flag).
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: _create_window raising: error propagates, _opening is reset, and a second open succeeds returning view-1. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 18 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_open_view_does_not_report_a_window_superseded_during_creation
methods.review_note: Added. When window creation reports not committed, open_view returns '' and does not notify visibility.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: _create_window returning False yields an empty string and no notify call. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 13 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_hotlink_open_uses_saved_normal_annotation_window_state
methods.review_note: Saved normal state restores geometry bytes, not maximized/fullscreen, and uses 'hotlink' navigation. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Hotlink open (named view uid) with a saved normal state: geometry bytes equal the saved bytes, not maximized/fullscreen, navigation_source 'hotlink', notify after. Geometry is encoded by the test helper independent of production. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 25 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_hotlink_open_restores_saved_maximized_only_when_saved
methods.review_note: Saved maximized state is restored with geometry and fullscreen stays False. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Saved maximized=True: window state maximized True and fullscreen False with the saved geometry bytes. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 17 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_hotlink_open_restores_saved_fullscreen_only_when_saved
methods.review_note: Saved fullscreen state restored, maximized stays False. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Saved fullscreen=True mirror of the maximized test. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 17 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_hotlink_open_without_saved_state_defaults_to_normal_window
methods.review_note: No provider gives None geometry and normal window. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: No saved-state provider: geometry None, not maximized, not fullscreen (the provider-None branch must not be called). Expected values equal the defaults, but the branch under test is the early return with a provider of None, which crashes if the guard is removed. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 10 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_explicit_auto_open_state_overrides_saved_hotlink_defaults
methods.review_note: Explicit geometry/flags override a maximized+fullscreen saved state. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Explicit geometry/False/False wins over a saved maximized+fullscreen state (the provider would give True/True): proves the explicit-wins rule rather than merge. Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 8 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_explicit_maximized_request_does_not_borrow_saved_geometry
methods.review_note: Added. An explicit initial_is_maximized request skips the saved state entirely (no saved geometry borrowed).

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_saved_window_geometry_decoding_rejects_malformed_values
methods.review_note: Added. _decode_window_geometry: None stays None, valid base64 round-trips, non-ASCII or non-string values become an empty QByteArray.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Static _decode_window_geometry: None -> None, valid base64 -> exact bytes, non-ASCII string and non-string -> empty QByteArray. Literal inputs; the empty-string case is not asserted (decodes to empty either way, no observable branch). Compared with the first-pass note afterwards: no disagreement. Kills 14 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_bring_to_front_does_not_maximize_windowed_minimized_window

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_bring_to_front_preserves_maximized_minimized_window
methods.review_note: Strengthened: also asserts raise and activate are called for the maximized restore path.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_bring_to_front_only_raises_a_visible_window_and_ignores_closed_manager

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_refresh_window_updates_navigation_before_page_content
methods.review_note: Exact order navigation -> access -> page. Sound.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_database_refresh_refreshes_matching_detached_view
methods.review_note: Strengthened: intermediate assertions after the non-matching refresh, plus an empty file_path (global refresh) refreshes and a closed window ignores the event.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: _on_database_refreshed with a real AnnotationView and stub project data: a different file is ignored, the matching file and a blank file path (matches any view) each request exactly one refresh, and a closed manager requests nothing. Counted request list, positive and negative controls in one test. Finding (design, not changed): this handler compares file paths with plain != while _on_file_unloaded normalises paths with normalize_path; the contract for event path spelling is not documented. Kills 16 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_database_refresh_invalidates_page_images_unless_sources_are_unchanged
methods.review_note: Added. Page image and overlay sources are invalidated on refresh, skipped when image_sources_unchanged, and skipped when the view's bid is not the current bid.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Patches invalidate_source_files at the manager module: a normal refresh invalidates exactly (image_path, overlay_image_path) of the target page, image_sources_unchanged=True suppresses it, and a view whose Bid is not the current Bid does not invalidate (so a stale page of another Bid is never touched). Literal tuple expected. Kills 22 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_external_access_refresh_clears_matching_detached_undo_history
methods.review_note: Exact sequence: other file ignored; matching local refresh requests refresh only; external change cancels, clears undo, refreshes. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Exact call order across three events: other file with external_change does nothing; a plain matching refresh only requests; a matching external refresh runs prepare_for_authoritative_refresh (cancel), clears the undo history, then requests the refresh (['refresh','cancel','undo','refresh']). Database unload semantics are covered by the _on_file_unloaded tests in DetachedLifecycleBranchTests. Kills 18 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_capability_change_updates_access_without_page_refresh
methods.review_note: Access listener pushes the new capability state to the window with no page refresh (the manager has no signaler, so a refresh would raise). Sound.

Kills 14 mutants. Note (stale copies): _refresh_access_state reads the window's page_data, which can lag the project model by one projection; covered by the world test that reprojects.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_access_listener_lifecycle_has_no_duplicates_or_closed_updates
methods.review_note: Duplicate registration is a no-op, notify updates the window, close_view unregisters and clears interactions, and later notifies do nothing. Sound.

Exact counts. Kills 34 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_shutdown_releases_access_listener_and_surface_interaction
methods.review_note: Strengthened: asserts the listener was registered before shutdown and that the access owner and registration flag are released afterwards.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_shutdown_continues_after_independent_cleanup_failures
methods.review_note: Strengthened: the exact five logged failure messages (access listener, first event unsubscribe, pipeline, signaler, window close) are asserted instead of only assertLogs, proving every independent step still ran.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Every cleanup step fails independently (access unsubscribe, first event unsubscribe, pipeline cleanup, signaler cleanup, window close): shutdown logs exactly the five messages in order, still unsubscribes all 13 events, clears the interaction, deletes the signaler, closes the window, publishes visibility False, nulls all collaborators, and a second shutdown is a no-op. Strong; messages are literals. Kills 57 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_window_destruction_releases_access_listener_and_surface_interaction
methods.review_note: Window destruction releases listener and interaction and clears the window. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Destruction of the current window (identity match) clears the window, undo service, listener and interaction. Kills 19 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_access_owner_remains_stable_across_lifecycle_release
methods.review_note: Strengthened: it only asserted the owner object; now verifies close_view releases the listener/interaction/opening flag while keeping the owner, and that the listener can register again.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_context_uses_target_page_and_surface_identity

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_context_reports_hidden_annotation_layer

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_interaction_signal_updates_its_surface_only

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_text_edit_signal_updates_its_surface_only

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_interaction_signals_are_ignored_without_an_open_window_or_access_owner

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_takeoff_refresh_isolated_to_matching_bid_without_navigation_rebuild
methods.review_note: Mismatched current bid does nothing; matching one updates indicator, access, page and never rebuilds navigation. Sound.

Kills 29 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_multi_page_events_refresh_matching_detached_page_once
methods.review_note: Deduplicated page uids, empty event ignored, annotation event for other pages does not refresh. Sound.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_takeoff_event_for_another_page_updates_only_its_indicator

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_refresh_window_retargets_deleted_active_page

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_missing_target_retargeting_keeps_existing_pages_and_clears_empty_bids

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_refresh_window_does_not_retarget_missing_page_for_inactive_bid

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_layer_visibility_event_refreshes_matching_detached_view

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_annotation_change_refresh_uses_target_page_uid
methods.review_note: Strengthened: page_uids list variants (matching, non-matching), empty event (refresh) and closed window.

Kills 22 mutants. Mutant 1060 (set() unwrapped to a list) is equivalent for membership/truthiness.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_bid_content_refreshes_matching_detached_view

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_local_bid_content_completion_preserves_detached_undo_history

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_local_completion_keeps_active_detached_interaction_unlike_remote_change

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_combined_remote_annotation_layer_change_refreshes_detached_view_once

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_takeoff_change_cancels_detached_interaction_before_refresh

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_annotation_on_other_page_does_not_cancel_detached_view

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_named_view_deletion_clears_detached_named_view_target

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_annotation_change_keeps_existing_named_view_target

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_annotation_projection_skips_unaffected_detached_page
