methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_hierarchy_refreshes_matching_detached_database

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Other database ignored; matching database with the Bid still resolvable requests a refresh without clearing undo (['refresh']). Kills 18 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_bid_removal_clears_detached_undo_before_refresh
methods.review_note: Missing bid clears undo before refresh. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Bid no longer resolvable after a hierarchy change: undo cleared first, then refresh (['undo','refresh']). Kills 12 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_condition_and_area_changes_refresh_matching_detached_view
methods.review_note: Strengthened: notes-only change, deferred projection and events for another database/bid never refresh.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Condition and area events against the displayed Bid: undo-invalidating events clear undo and refresh; a plan-relevant field ('name') refreshes without undo; with no undo service the refresh still happens; notes-only fields, deferred projections and other database/Bid events produce no refresh (count unchanged). The plan-relevance rule is evaluated by the real condition_changes_require_plan_refresh. Kills 39 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_local_area_completion_preserves_detached_interaction_and_undo
methods.review_note: Local area completion refreshes without cancel/undo. Sound.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Local area completion with an active blocker: only the refresh, no cancel and no undo clear. Kills 25 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_remote_area_change_cancels_detached_interaction_before_undo_and_refresh
methods.review_note: Added. Remote area changes cancel the blocked interaction once, then clear undo and refresh; deferred projection only clears undo; a notes-only condition change with invalidated undo clears undo without cancelling or refreshing (kills the condition undo-plan guard).
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: Blocker flag that the cancel stub clears: other database ignored; remote area change gives exactly ['cancel','undo','refresh']; deferred projection only clears undo; a notes-only condition change with invalidates_undo clears undo but does not cancel or refresh. Note: the cancel call in _on_remote_areas_changed is duplicated by the one inside _on_conditions_changed, so removing the outer call is unobservable (mutant 418 equivalence proof: the stub clears the blocker on the first cancel, the real window's prepare_for_authoritative_refresh also clears every blocker input). Kills 43 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_deleted_bid_areas_clear_undo_only_for_the_displayed_bid

methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: BID_AREAS_DELETED clears undo only for the displayed (database, bid) with a non-empty area list; other Bid, other database and empty list do not; a missing undo service is tolerated. Kills 10 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_deleted_annotation_lifetimes_are_forwarded_to_detached_undo_history

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_page_navigation_cancels_interaction_before_retarget

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_successful_detached_scale_save_does_not_refresh

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_scale_change_for_another_page_or_database_is_not_saved

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_scale_save_exception_is_logged_and_refreshes_window

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_scale_rejected_by_queue_refreshes_window

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_sql_scale_uses_queued_page_setting_path
methods.review_note: Strengthened: iterates every MutationOutcomeStatus to pin which refresh (REJECTED/CONFLICT/FAILED_BEFORE_COMMIT/CANCELLED_BEFORE_START) and which do not (committed variants), and verifies no refresh when the displayed page changed or the window closed.
methods.second_pass_note: Second pass: SQL path: the queue receives literal (database, page, 'scale', [sf1, sf2]) and owning_surface='detached-plan'; the synchronous save is never used; the captured completion callback is then fed a QueuedMutationResult for EVERY MutationOutcomeStatus member (subTest over the enum): only REJECTED, CONFLICT, FAILED_BEFORE_COMMIT and CANCELLED_BEFORE_START refresh; committed/unknown/projection-failed outcomes do not; a completion after the page changed or the window closed does nothing. Enumeration over the real enum means a new status must be classified deliberately. Kills 45 mutants.

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_deferred_remote_page_deletion_retargets_before_projection

methods.name: DetachedPageViewManagerLifecycleTests.test_detached_view_projects_independent_capabilities

methods.review_note: Added (second pass): AGENTS.md 'Deferred remote Page projection must run the existing missing-target fallback even when an empty Bid left the detached target UID blank, so its first new Page restores content and controls without manual navigation'. methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_threejs_adapter_orders_and_filters_listed_layers_and_areas
methods.review_note: Added: layers sorted by sequence, blank/duplicate uids dropped, name falls back to uid, page image layer not duplicated when its uid is already a layer; areas sorted by sequence, unassigned uid '0' and duplicates dropped. Kills mutants removing the seen guard, the unassigned filter and the sort key.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_threejs_adapter_deduplicates_conditions_and_skips_empty_meshes
methods.review_note: Added: two meshes of one condition give one condition entry (first name wins), empty meshes yield no geometry but still contribute their condition metadata, blank condition uid never creates an entry; default cdn type 'Unknown' and ref_no 0. Kills the condition dedupe/blank-uid mutant.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_threejs_adapter_frames_camera_and_bounds_in_y_up_space
methods.review_note: Added: exact camera position/target and scene bounds for asymmetric bounds (centre (20,1,3) -> (20,3,-1), framing 1.5x the longest extent) and the 1-unit minimum framing for tiny scenes. Kills sign/axis and minimum-size mutants.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_threejs_adapter_convert_mesh_splits_creased_vertices_and_defaults_metadata
methods.review_note: Added: vertex-exact and normal-exact geometry for a 90 degree crease (6 split vertices, index buffer [0,2,4,1,3,5], normals mapped (x,y,z)->(x,z,-y)), default colour 128/255 grey, opacity 1, name 'Mesh', visible, cdn 'Unknown', and None for an empty mesh. Kills the normal axis mapping mutant.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_threejs_adapter_preserves_visibility_metadata_for_transparent_meshes
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added the exact colour of '#336699' ([51,102,153]/255) so the colour parser is not hidden by the all-red fixture used elsewhere; opacity 0.5 and visible False remain asserted. Kills opacity, visible and colour hard-coding mutants.

methods.name: ProcessMeshesForThreejsTests.test_metadata_retains_page_area_layer_and_condition_identity
methods.review_note: Strengthened: autospecced collaborators; asserts the complete 16-key metadata dict (colour, opacity, uids, area name, layer, visible, name, cdn type, condition colour '#996633' from BGR fill, ref_no, IsNegativeQuantity), that MeshFactory is built with the coord system, that the boolean pass receives the raw mesh+metadata and that returned meshes/bounds are the boolean output (-1,7,-2,8,-3,9). Mutants (bounds from raw list, hard-coded visible, condition colour, area_name) are killed.

methods.name: ProcessMeshesForThreejsTests.test_unnamed_unassigned_takeoff_uses_fallback_labels
methods.review_note: Added: unnamed condition -> 'Element <takeoff uid>', empty cdn name -> 'Unknown', blank layer/page/cdn uid, area '' with '' name when the area list has other areas, color_fill 0 -> '#000000', negative takeoff flag propagates. Kills name, cdn_type_name and IsNegativeQuantity mutants.

methods.name: ProcessMeshesForThreejsTests.test_missing_conditions_and_empty_meshes_do_not_publish_metadata
methods.review_note: Strengthened: now has a positive control (a real mesh among a missing-condition takeoff, an empty MeshData and a None mesh); asserts which takeoffs reach the factory in order, that only 'kept' is published with its real mesh, exact bounds (0,2,0,3,0,1) and a single colour lookup. Kills the missing-condition guard removal.

methods.name: ProcessMeshesForThreejsTests.test_no_meshes_yield_default_bounds
methods.review_note: Retained from the second half of the original test (empty mesh result): no metadata, default bounds (-1000,1000,-1000,1000,-10,10) and no colour lookup.

methods.name: ProcessMeshesForThreejsTests.test_meshes_are_emitted_area_then_linear_then_count_then_attachment
methods.review_note: Added: with a scrambled grouping dict the emission order is area, linear, count, attachment (type ids 1,0,2,3) and condition_type metadata matches. Kills the order and missing-type mutants.

methods.name: ProcessMeshesForThreejsTests.test_area_holes_and_display_options_reach_their_collaborators
methods.review_note: Added: valid hole polygons (>=3 points) reach create_mesh_for_takeoff as vertex lists while a 1-point hole is dropped; grouping uses the exportable (hole-free) takeoffs; display mode, grayscale flag, page area selections and inactive colour are forwarded to the colour service. Kills holes=None, wrong grouping input, grayscale and selection forwarding mutants.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_html_generation_escapes_title_and_script_terminators
methods.review_note: Retained: real _generate_html over the real viewer.html; asserts the escaped <title> text, absence of the raw injected script and a lossless json round trip of the scene block. Mutants removing the '<' escape or html.escape are killed.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_html_generation_does_not_expand_template_placeholders_in_user_text
methods.review_note: Added: regression for the double-substitution defect. A title or scene text containing '{{SCENE_DATA}}' / '{{TITLE}}' must be emitted literally; before the fix the title tag contained the whole scene JSON. Passes only with the single-pass substitution (the old two-step replace mutant is killed).

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_viewer_renders_elevation_callouts_in_plan_svg_only
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added a parsed-JSON equality of the embedded elevation_callouts payload; the many substring checks of the viewer JS/CSS are retained as source-contract pins (mutating ELEVATION_CALLOUT_LINE_SPACING is killed). Limitation: they check source text, not behaviour; the executable behaviour of the visibility code is covered by ThreejsViewerScriptTests.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_viewer_uses_bounds_aware_dynamic_camera_clipping
methods.review_note: Retained: source-contract substring pins for the clipping helpers and the removed fixed 0.1/100000 range; renaming getSceneDepthRange is killed. Cannot prove camera behaviour without WebGL; the syntax gate ThreejsViewerScriptTests.test_every_inline_script_parses protects the script from being unparseable.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_viewer_uses_layer_panel_visibility_wiring
methods.review_note: Retained: large source-contract pin of the layer/condition/area/page visibility wiring and DOM ids (mutating the layerVisibility Map type is killed); behaviour of the combined visibility predicate is now executed under Node in ThreejsViewerScriptTests.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_viewer_combines_layer_condition_and_area_visibility
methods.review_note: Retained as a source pin of isObjectVisible/isGroupVisible; the logic itself is now exercised by ThreejsViewerScriptTests.test_object_visibility_combines_base_page_layer_condition_and_area.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_wboit_transparent_mesh_render_respects_visibility_filters
methods.review_note: Retained as a source pin (renderWboitPassWithVisibility, material swap/restore); the swap/restore algorithm is executed under Node in ThreejsViewerScriptTests.test_transparent_pass_hides_materials_of_invisible_objects_and_restores_them.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_scene_json_includes_split_display_modes
methods.review_note: Strengthened: the embedded scene JSON is parsed and its display_modes compared for equality (synced False, Solid/Transparent); the substring checks stay.

methods.name: ThreejsHtmlViewerTests.test_wboit_detection_uses_3d_geometry_opacity_only
methods.review_note: Strengthened: besides the substring pin of the geometry-opacity rule, asserts the transparency flag is declared and set exactly once, so 2D takeoff opacity cannot enable the OIT pass elsewhere in the script (mutating '<' to '<=' is killed). The loop itself is module top-level JS and cannot be executed in isolation.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_html_scene_adds_callouts_without_changing_3d_geometry_data
methods.review_note: Strengthened: stage collaborators (mesh processing, adapter, page assembly, HTML) are patched; added assertions on pages, selected/active page uid, display_modes, absence of pdf_documents, forwarding of include_elevation_callouts, page_floor_elevations {'page-1': 0.0} and callout colour to _build_multi_page_data, and the exact file written. Kills the temp-file/auto_open mutants.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_html_scene_omits_callout_data_and_resolution_when_disabled
methods.review_note: Retained: with callouts disabled the page builder receives include_elevation_callouts False and floor elevations derived from the mesh, and the scene has no elevation_callouts key (stages patched, native tessellation faked).

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_nothing_to_visualize_returns_none_without_running_any_stage
methods.review_note: Added: no conditions or no takeoffs returns None before mesh processing, HTML generation or file output (autospecced stages). Kills the and/or guard mutant.

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_empty_mesh_result_returns_none_without_writing_html
methods.review_note: Added: an empty processed mesh list returns None, never builds the scene or the HTML and leaves no file. Kills the removed empty guard.

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_display_modes_flags_and_mesh_options_are_forwarded
methods.review_note: Added: 3D display mode/grayscale/area selections go to mesh processing, the 2D display mode/grayscale/selections go to the page builder, scene display_modes records both modes and the synced flag, and the title reaches the HTML stage. Kills mode swap and synced hard-coding mutants.

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_page_floor_elevations_are_the_lowest_mesh_vertex_of_each_page
methods.review_note: Added: page floor elevation is the minimum z over each page's mesh vertices ({'page-1': -3.0, 'page-2': 7.0}) and meshes without a page uid are ignored (AGENTS.md page-plane elevation ownership). Kills the wrong-axis mutant.

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_exported_pages_set_selection_and_resolve_the_active_page
methods.review_note: Added: exported pages become selected_page_uids, a requested active page is kept only if exported (else the first), pdf_documents/elevation_callouts keys appear only when non-empty. Kills the three conditional-key mutants and the active-page guard.

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_scene_without_exported_pages_has_no_page_keys
methods.review_note: Added: without page entries the scene carries none of the page keys. Kills the 'if page_entries' guard mutant.

methods.name: VisualizeWithThreejsPipelineTests.test_html_is_written_to_a_temp_file_and_opened_only_when_requested
methods.review_note: Added: output_path None creates a real .html temp file with the generated content, the browser is opened only with auto_open and with the resolved file URI. Kills the always-open and always-temp mutants.

methods.name: ThreejsViewerScriptTests.test_every_inline_script_parses
methods.review_note: Added: executes `node --check` on the viewer's inline classic and module scripts and json-parses the scene and importmap blocks, so a syntactically broken template can no longer pass the substring tests (an injected extra brace is killed). Requires Node.js (skipUnless); node is available on this machine and the test ran.

methods.name: ThreejsViewerScriptTests.test_object_visibility_combines_base_page_layer_condition_and_area
methods.review_note: Added: extracts isGroupVisible/isObjectVisible from viewer.html and runs 11 cases under Node: each of layer/condition/area/page hidden, page hiding ignored for 2D overlays, baseVisible false, blank uids always visible, unregistered uids visible. Kills five viewer.html mutants.

methods.name: ThreejsViewerScriptTests.test_transparent_pass_hides_materials_of_invisible_objects_and_restores_them
methods.review_note: Added: runs renderWboitPassWithVisibility under Node with a stub scene: invisible objects lose their material during the pass, objects without material are untouched, everything is restored afterwards and also when the pass throws. Kills removal of the material null-out, the restore and the try/finally.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_two_d_takeoff_export_includes_visibility_metadata_and_rings
methods.review_note: Strengthened: replaced 'ring has >= 3 points' with the exact ring [[0,0],[72,0],[72,72]] (1 OST unit = 72 pt, no y flip), and asserted name and opacity next to the existing uid/layer/kind/colour/visibility checks. Kills the visible-flag and layer-uid mutants.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_two_d_takeoff_export_resolves_callout_in_same_geometry_pass
methods.review_note: Strengthened: the callout centre was derived from the production ring; it is now the literal (3600, 4500) and the ring itself is asserted exactly (7200 x 9000 pt). Callout lines (410'-3", 406'-3", 12.86 CY) were already literal and verified by hand (48 in slab, 100x125 in^2). Kills hole-forwarding and callout colour mutants together with the new hole test.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_two_d_takeoff_export_uses_configured_callout_content
methods.review_note: Retained: configured settings reduce the callout to the single top line 410' - 3"; literal expectation, real elevation callout service.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_two_d_takeoff_export_skips_callout_resolution_when_disabled
methods.review_note: Strengthened: the resolver patch is now autospec=True (was a bare MagicMock); still asserts one entry, no callouts and that the resolver is never called. Mutating the disabled-guard is killed.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_two_d_takeoff_export_keeps_unassigned_area_empty
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added an assigned-area takeoff as positive control, asserts kind 'count' and the exact 72 pt square footprint [[36,36],[108,36],[108,108],[36,108]] besides the blank area uid for '0'. Kills the area_group_uid mutant.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_split_display_modes_control_3d_and_2d_opacity_independently
methods.review_note: Strengthened: added a Solid-mode control (opacity 1.0) next to the Transparent-mode 0.5 so the asserted value is not the default; the first half remains a cross-check of ColorService 3D vs 2D opacity.

methods.name: ThreejsExportLayerTests.test_original_2d_display_mode_uses_2d_pattern_opacity
methods.review_note: Strengthened: loops pattern 1 (solid, 1.0), 2 (line pattern, 0.0) and 8 (transparent, 0.5) in Original mode instead of only the 0.0 case, so the pattern-to-opacity mapping is exercised end to end.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_area_holes_become_inner_rings_after_the_outer_ring
methods.review_note: Added: vertex-exact outer ring (288 pt square) followed by the inner hole ring; the hole takeoff is not emitted as its own entry and a 2-point hole is dropped. Kills the hole-append mutant.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_straight_linear_ring_is_a_thickness_wide_rectangle
methods.review_note: Added: horizontal and vertical straight linear takeoffs give exact thickness-wide rectangles (+-18 pt for 0.5 unit). Hand computed from 72 pt per unit.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_linear_thickness_defaults_to_one_unit_and_has_a_visible_minimum
methods.review_note: Added: no thickness defaults to 1 unit (+-36 pt) and a 0.01 unit hairline is widened to the 2 pt rendering minimum. Kills the default and max() mutants.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_callout_quantity_excludes_holes_and_sits_on_the_outer_ring
methods.review_note: Added: with a 10x10 hole the cubic yards drop from 12.86 to 12.76 and the callout stays on the outer ring centre (3600,4500). Kills hole-list forwarding to the callout resolver and the rings[-1] mutant.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_callout_without_any_selected_content_is_omitted_but_entry_is_kept
methods.review_note: Added: settings with no content produce no callout while the entry stays; default settings produce one (positive control). Kills the removed 'resolved is None' guard.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_takeoffs_without_condition_or_enough_position_are_omitted
methods.review_note: Added: orphan, 2-point area, 1-point line and empty-position takeoffs are omitted while a valid one remains. The len(position)<6 / <4 guards are partly redundant with the later ring-size checks (equivalent mutants).

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_entry_metadata_name_negative_flag_and_inactive_color
methods.review_note: Added: name fallback 'Takeoff <uid>', is_negative propagation and inactive-Area recolouring only for takeoffs outside the page's selected Area. Kills name, flag and selection-forwarding mutants.

methods.name: TwoDTakeoffRingTests.test_grayscale_default_desaturates_entry_colors
methods.review_note: Added: default grayscale desaturates '#996633' to '#6f6f6f' (0.299/0.587/0.114 weights) while grayscale disabled keeps the colour. Kills the grayscale-forwarding mutant.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_numeric_rgb_sequence_is_not_treated_as_color_opacity_pair
methods.review_note: Retained: literal (1.0, 128/255, 0.0, 1.0) for a 3-number sequence, guarding against the (color, opacity) pair interpretation.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_numeric_rgba_sequence_converts_to_hex_with_opacity
methods.review_note: Retained: literal ('#ff8000', 0.25); extended coverage for rounding is in the as_hex_with_opacity table test.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_condition_color_preserves_black_fill
methods.review_note: Retained: black fill 0 stays [0,0,0] (kills the 'or 255' mutant); the fallback side now has its own test.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_condition_color_uses_bgr_fill_and_defaults_missing_fill_to_red
methods.review_note: Added: 0x336699 is a BGR integer -> [0x99,0x66,0x33] and a None fill defaults to 255 (pure red). Kills channel order and default mutants.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_convert_to_rgba_parses_strings_dicts_pairs_and_clamps
methods.review_note: Added: table of 12 entry shapes (hex, rgb/rgba strings 0-255 and 0-1, dict opacity clamping both ends, rgba alpha times opacity, (color, opacity) pair, float triple, invalid hex, empty dict, None). Kills clamp, alpha product, 255-scale threshold and short-hex mutants.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_as_hex_with_opacity_normalizes_every_entry_shape
methods.review_note: Added: dict/str/empty/pair/float-triple/None entries including 0.5 -> '#808080' (round, not truncate) and opacity clamping. Kills the round->int mutant.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_hex_helpers_round_trip_bgr_integers
methods.review_note: Added: int_to_hex BGR channel order, hex_to_rgb(_int), parse_hex_color with/without '#', 5-digit fallback to grey. Kills the 6-digit length mutant.

methods.name: ColorServiceTests.test_inactive_area_takeoff_requires_a_different_selected_area
methods.review_note: Added: inactive only when the page has a selected Area different from the takeoff's; None/empty selections, same Area, None selection and other page are active. Kills the always-compare mutant.

methods.name: ColorMappingTests.test_solid_mapping_covers_only_used_conditions_with_full_opacity
methods.review_note: Added: only conditions used by takeoffs (unused c4 and the foreign takeoff excluded) with exact hex/opacity.

methods.name: ColorMappingTests.test_hierarchy_groups_identical_conditions_by_type_name
methods.review_note: Added: legend grouped by type name ('Concrete', 'Unknown' fallback) with identical name/z/colour merged to count 2; the representative uid is asserted as one of two because set iteration order is not deterministic.

methods.name: ColorMappingTests.test_transparent_mode_halves_opacity
methods.review_note: Added: Transparent display mode halves every opacity; colour unchanged. Kills the 0.5 factor and mode mutants.

methods.name: ColorMappingTests.test_original_mode_takes_opacity_from_the_2d_pattern
methods.review_note: Added: Original mode applies pattern 2D opacity (solid 1.0, line pattern 0.0, transparent 0.5). Kills the mode-comparison mutant.

methods.name: ColorMappingTests.test_grayscale_desaturates_colors_and_legend_but_keeps_opacity
methods.review_note: Added: '#996633' -> '#6f6f6f' in both the colour map and the legend with opacity preserved. Kills the weight and legend mutants.

methods.name: ColorMappingTests.test_extra_condition_uids_add_known_conditions_only
methods.review_note: Added: extra uids add known conditions and ignore unknown ones.

methods.name: ColorServiceOpacityTests.test_inactive_color_substitution_preserves_opacity
methods.review_note: Retained (body unchanged, Qt setUp removed): inactive Area replaces the colour but keeps opacity 0.37 for both 2D and 3D; positive controls are in the next test. Kills the substitution-removal mutant.

methods.name: ColorServiceOpacityTests.test_active_or_unrestricted_takeoffs_keep_their_color
methods.review_note: Added: the sibling positive control: no/empty selections, same Area, None selection, other page all keep '#abcdef'/0.37 for 2D and 3D.

methods.name: ColorServiceOpacityTests.test_missing_color_map_entry_falls_back_to_opaque_gray
methods.review_note: Added: a condition absent from the colour map renders '#808080' at opacity 1.0 in 2D and 3D.

methods.name: ColorServiceOpacityTests.test_original_mode_3d_opacity_comes_from_the_pattern_not_the_color_map
methods.review_note: Added: Original mode 3D opacity is 1.0 for solid or missing pattern and 0.5 for others, while the 2D query keeps the map opacity. Kills the pattern default mutant.

methods.name: ColorServiceOpacityTests.test_non_original_modes_ignore_the_pattern_for_3d_opacity
methods.review_note: Added: Solid and Transparent modes ignore the pattern for 3D opacity. Kills the mode-comparison mutant.

methods.name: ColorServiceOpacityTests.test_original_mode_inactive_takeoff_keeps_pattern_opacity
methods.review_note: Added: inactive recolouring in Original mode keeps the pattern-derived 0.5 opacity.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_unchecked_active_page_falls_back_to_first_checked_page
methods.review_note: Retained: active page not among the checked pages falls back to the first checked page; the positive side (active checked wins) is covered by test_active_checked_page_switch_uses_matching_page_elevation and the active-guard mutant is killed by two tests.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_fallback_page_is_stable_for_equivalent_checked_page_orderings
methods.review_note: Retained: both orderings give 'page-a' (sorted normalisation); selected[-1] mutant killed.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_render_scale_is_bounded_for_large_pages
methods.review_note: Strengthened: besides the inequalities, scale is exactly 4096/9000 and the long side lands on 4096 px. Kills the min/max mutant.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_render_scale_is_native_for_pages_within_limits_and_invalid_sizes
methods.review_note: Added: in-limit page and zero/negative/None sizes use the native scale 1.0.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_render_scale_uses_shared_floor_for_extreme_pages
methods.review_note: Retained: absurd size clamps to CONSTRAINED_RENDER_SCALE_FLOOR exactly.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_qimage_to_rgba_bytes_returns_packed_rgba
methods.review_note: Retained: exact packed bytes for a 2x1 RGBA image; truncation mutant killed.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_qimage_to_rgba_bytes_converts_other_formats_to_rgba_byte_order
methods.review_note: Added: ARGB32 input converts to R,G,B,A byte order with straight alpha. Kills the wrong-target-format mutant.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_qimage_to_rgba_bytes_rejects_missing_and_null_images
methods.review_note: Added: None and null QImage return None (the isNull guard is partly redundant with the width check, an equivalent mutant).

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_provider_builds_active_page_plane_from_existing_page_cache
methods.review_note: Strengthened: now also asserts the exact pixel bytes, opacity 1.0, flip_u True/flip_v False, and the whole cache call (source path, page index 2, native scale 1.0, rotation 0); layer_visible False -> visible False has its positive control in test_visible_page_layer_makes_plane_visible. Kills plane_z, flip_v, page_height, scale and visible mutants.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_active_2d_page_cannot_supply_another_checked_pages_elevation
methods.review_note: Retained: active page absent from the checked set must not supply its elevation (-100 - 0.01 for page-b); active-guard mutant killed.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_active_checked_page_switch_uses_matching_page_elevation
methods.review_note: Retained: switching the active checked page and reordering the checked list yields the matching page's elevation and identical plane data; the elevation lookup mutant is killed.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_visible_page_layer_makes_plane_visible
methods.review_note: Added: positive control for the layer visibility flag.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_rotation_flip_and_effects_are_applied_to_the_unrotated_render
methods.review_note: Added: on a 2x2 image with four distinct pixels, flip_x, flip_y, both flips, rotation 90 and invert produce the exact expected byte layouts, and the cache is always asked for rotation 0. Kills rotation sign, flip axis swap, effect swap and rotated-render mutants.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_rotation_by_a_quarter_turn_swaps_texture_dimensions
methods.review_note: Added: a 2x1 texture at rotation 90 becomes 1x2 with the right pixel on top (counter-clockwise turn).

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_large_page_is_rendered_at_the_bounded_texture_scale
methods.review_note: Added: provider passes the bounded scale 4096/9000 to the page cache for a 9000x6000 pt page.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_bitonal_effect_clamps_paper_white_in_the_texture
methods.review_note: Added: bitonal effect turns white into (220,220,220,255) in the plane bytes; invert/bitonal swap mutant killed.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_pages_without_usable_source_or_size_supply_no_plane
methods.review_note: Added: no image path, missing file, overlay-only mode without overlay and zero page size each supply no plane and never touch the cache; a valid page is the positive control. Kills the isfile guard removal.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_null_rendered_image_supplies_no_plane

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_page_without_floor_elevation_or_project_record_supplies_no_plane
methods.review_note: Added: page missing from the elevation map or unknown to the project supplies no plane; present elevation is the control.

methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_display_mode_routes_to_composite_overlay_or_original_render
methods.review_note: Added: with an explicit recording composite renderer, Original reads the page cache, Overlay calls render_overlay_only untinted, Both calls render_composite with the bid ref, scale and rotation 0, Both with only an overlay uses the (80,80,255) tint, Both without overlay falls back to the original; the page passed to composition is unrotated and unflipped. methods.name: NativePageImagePlaneTests.test_checked_page_without_geometry_does_not_create_origin_plane
methods.review_note: Retained: a checked page with no floor elevation produces None instead of an origin plane (the provider would raise on the fake project data if the guard were removed).

methods.name: RenderSurfaceSizingTests.test_logical_dimensions_convert_to_physical_pixels_once
methods.review_note: Retained: five DPRs with literal physical sizes (1.5 -> 1202/905 pins half-up rounding); mutating the rounding to floor is killed.

methods.name: RenderSurfaceSizingTests.test_one_hundred_percent_scaling_is_unchanged
methods.review_note: Retained: 1920x1080 and point (319,241) unchanged at DPR 1.

methods.name: SqlDevelopmentPrimitiveTests.test_a_secrets_file_is_created_exclusively_owner_only_and_durable_before_rename

The spy records but does not carry out a close, so a mutant closing fd 1 cannot corrupt the runner. Killed: mode 0o600 +/-1, dropped flush, descriptor reset value 1/2 (a double close of a stray descriptor; the automatic runner reports these as no-verdict because the mutant also closes stdout in unrelated tests, the dedicated test was run alone and KILLS them).
